gpuReservation.sharedMachineNotes: Public co-tenants remain on amd-host (4103868, 4121371) and are not addressed. intel-host is not used by this placement. Functional numerical route with retained driver caches; not cold-start, isolation or throughput acceptance.
gpuReservation.scope: Three logical stages on two physical hosts, 55 unchanged independent F64 prefixes; stop on first numerical failure. Same reference, tolerance, deadlines and limits as campaign 3; the runtime archive (3b132ee7, Doppler 77c5d9b2), the combined kernel manifest with the declared Q/K head-norm program and the rolled sliced state program (548e6559), the placement and the declared preparation bound (limits.maxPreparationMs 1200000) change.
gpuReservation.preparation: Generation 3, the chosen recurrent-state variant (rolled row loops; variant-choice/README.md): archive 3b132ee7 (Doppler 77c5d9b2) and manifest 548e6559. Expected identities are fresh load-only observations of all three stages (observation-3/*.json; no token executed). Generation 2 (unrolled) passed in c3 and is retained. Native limits as c3 (3,540,000 ms deadline inside a 3,600 s scope). Attempt c4 compared all 55 prefixes within 0.001 but both amd-host resident closes exceeded the 10,000 ms cleanup limit while mac-host to amd-host round trips rose to 0.8-1.0 s (journeys/logs/mac-health.log); both providers exited 0. c5 repeats it unchanged. Attempt c5 reached 33 of 55 prefixes, all within 0.001, before the Mac browser owner closed Chromium at its 1,740,000 ms deadline (mac-host to amd-host round trips of 0.4-1.3 s during the capture). c6 gives the Mac owner the same 3,540,000 ms deadline as the natives. Attempt c6 compared all 55 prefixes within 0.001, but the stage-1 resident close exceeded 10,000 ms (ownership unknown, one attempt unsettled) while mac-host to amd-host round trips were 0.5-1.5 s with a ping timeout; stage 2 then closed in 1.5 s once round trips recovered. The capture streams the output stage logits and stage evidence through the controller, and round trips rose as soon as decode began in c4 to c6. c7 runs the same unchanged controller on amd-host instead (bounded scope), so both AMD stage calls are local loopback and only the Mac stage call crosses the network (CDP over a reverse tunnel on the same port, so every endpoint URL is identical on both hosts).
